ideas.pitch: An AI agent built on Caspian deployed directly into university club and study group Discord servers to manage scheduling, resource sharing, and daily check-ins.
ideas.title: Caspian Campus Connect
ideas.why_it_could_win: Targeting high-frequency university peer groups guarantees organic message volume and daily consistency, which makes up 40% of the core judging criteria.

ideas.pitch: A Telegram and Discord-native AI agent that automatically collects daily asynchronous standups from early-stage startup teams, summarizes blockers, and updates project management boards.
ideas.title: Caspian Founder Standup
ideas.why_it_could_win: By solving a daily administrative pain point for startup founders and teammates, the agent will naturally achieve high active days and steady message volume.

ideas.pitch: An AI agent embedded in creator and indie hacker communities that tracks daily micro-milestones, aggregates product feedback, and prompts members for engagement.
ideas.title: Caspian Indie Hacker Pulse
ideas.why_it_could_win: Focuses heavily on creativity and real-world impact by targeting active builder communities where message volume and consistency are naturally high.

ideas.pitch: An interactive AI tutoring agent integrated into private study group channels that quiz users daily, tracks progress streaks, and answers collaborative problem sets.
ideas.title: Caspian Study Buddy
ideas.why_it_could_win: Gamifying daily study habits drives high message volume and user retention, directly hitting the primary metrics judges are evaluating.

ideas.pitch: An ordering and coordination agent for local community buying groups and small food co-ops to handle weekly inventory questions, orders, and delivery schedules via chat.
ideas.title: Caspian Local Food Coop Agent
ideas.why_it_could_win: Demonstrates a unique, creative real-world use case with actual customers or community members rather than generic test scripts, maximizing the use case and impact score.
